# Remove the diarize process block from the presets section (last block)
import re
with open('asr-service.cpu.default.yml') as f:
    content = f.read()
# Find the diarize process block and remove it
marker = "      - process_type: diarize"
idx = content.find(marker)
if idx != -1:
    # Find start of that list item (the line with '- process_type: diarize')
    line_start = content.rfind('\n', 0, idx) + 1
    # The block ends at end of file or next preset. Since it's the last item, remove to end of the diarize sub-keys.
    # Remove from line_start to end of file (it's the final block)
    content = content[:line_start]
    with open('asr-service.cpu.default.yml','w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("Removed diarize block. New length:", len(content))
else:
    print("marker not found")
PYEOF
